title: Select and implement enterprise data grids, virtualization, spreadsheets, and schedulers

contextSnapshot.surface: enterprise operations console with 50k-row order grid and resource scheduling calendar

prompt: Architect a 50,000-row virtualized data grid with server-side pagination and a timezone-aware scheduling calendar for our operations console.
forbiddenBehaviors: renders all 50,000 rows into the DOM without virtualization or server pagination
omits getRowId so selection/updates key by row index
omits aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex on virtualized tables

rubricDimensions.pass: chooses TanStack Table v8 + TanStack Virtual v3 or AG Grid v33+ (with granular ModuleRegistry and getRowId) and wires manual server-side sorting/pagination cleanly
rubricDimensions.fail: mounts unvirtualized 50k DOM rows or uses index-based row identity

rubricDimensions.pass: attaches data-index + measureElement for dynamic rows, sets aria-rowcount/aria-rowindex, and uses tabular-nums for numeric columns
rubricDimensions.fail: breaks variable row heights or hides dataset size from screen readers

rubricDimensions.pass: configures explicit timeZone, uses dateStr/UTC safely, and provides an accessible list/agenda view and click-based editing alternative
rubricDimensions.fail: relies on browser-local Date.toString() for named timezones or ships drag-only rescheduling

negativeControls.name: unvirtualized 50k table
negativeControls.input: map all 50,000 records directly to <tr> elements in React
negativeControls.mustNot: approve rendering tens of thousands of unvirtualized DOM rows

negativeControls.name: missing virtualizer data-index
negativeControls.mustNot: omit data-index when using TanStack Virtual dynamic measureElement

baseline.withoutSkill: renders unvirtualized rows or misconfigures AG Grid v33 modules/theming, omits getRowId and virtual ARIA counts, and mishandles calendar timezones
baseline.withSkill: selects TanStack Table/Virtual or tree-shaken AG Grid v33 with stable getRowId, dynamic measureElement, virtual ARIA semantics, and timezone-safe scheduling
